book_title: Toxic Bombs ~~War and Surviving: War and Surviving
author: Karen L.  West
book_description: In "Toxic Bombs: War and Living," survival is just the beginning. As chemical bombs rain down and foreign troops invade, ordinary Americans must band together in hidden communities, forging alliances and defending their loved ones against overwhelming odds. From the fortified safe haven of Willow's Rest to the embattled streets of Tucson and the wilds of Rocky Mountain National Park, families, veterans, and children face impossible choices, heartbreak, and moments of unexpected hope. With gripping action, resourceful characters, and a vivid portrayal of resilience, this story plunges readers into a world where courage and compassion are as vital as food and shelter. Will these survivors find a way to reclaim their country--and their future? Dive into this thrilling tale of endurance, ingenuity, and the unbreakable spirit of community.Show more
